name: Aircraft certification
payer: Manufacturer pays for certification work, much of it delegated to its own employees.
access: Regulator has statutory access; delegation reduces what it inspects directly.
publication: Type certificates public; findings largely internal.
ai_analogue: Delegation of certification to the regulated firm's own staff (ODA) is the closest analogue to labs running their own safety cases. The 737 MAX reforms show delegation can be reclaimed.

milestones.event: Air Commerce Act: federal certification of aircraft and pilots.
Federal Aviation Act creates the FAA.
Organization Designation Authorization lets manufacturers' employees perform certification work.
Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act: FAA approval of ODA unit members, expanded whistleblower protection, limits on delegation.

status: seed; secondary sources; verify each milestone against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Delegated certification staff now approved by the FAA after 2020.
